note: Split engine. validateReferral(state) is a completeness validator, not a score: it walks the 30 referralRules in catalogue order, counts only those whose applies() gate is open (REC-02 only when precautions.other is ticked; the three RFR receipt rules only once another receipt-side field has text), and returns { complete, totalRequired, totalSatisfied, sections (one bucket per section that had at least one applicable rule, in first-seen order), missing (fired rules in catalogue order) }. form-app.js calls detectFlaggedIssues(state) separately and stores it as flags, mirrored by flagsHint/flagsArgs; the oracle keeps it under expected.flaggedIssues. Flags are stable-sorted urgent > high > medium > low, so within a priority they keep detection order (infectious, SpO2, RR, GCS, SBP, HR, temp, aspiration, spinal, pregnancy, worsening, fall, weight-bearing, other, caution, mode). Quirks verified: (1) the receipt gates are asymmetric — arrival time alone opens RFR-01 and RFR-02 but RFR-03 opens only from provider name or signature, so an arrival-time-only receipt yields exactly two missing RFR rules; (2) REC-02 fires when 'Other' is ticked without details, yet FLAG-PRC-OTHER requires non-blank details, so the two never coincide; (3) vital-sign thresholds are asymmetric at the boundary: SpO2 90, RR 30, HR 130, SBP 90 and GCS 9 are all silent, but temperature >= 39 fires; (4) an ABCDE row is satisfied only when BOTH a finding (or Normal) AND an intervention (or None) are present. Regenerate expected with: bin/test-personas who-acute-referral-form --update

personas.name: Complete referral - stable closed femur fracture by ground ambulance
personas.description: Health-centre nurse refers a 31-year-old man with a closed mid-shaft femur fracture after a motorbike crash to the district hospital for orthopaedic fixation. Every required field filled, all ABCDE rows recorded (Normal/None or finding + intervention), no precautions ticked, pregnancy 'no', normal vital signs, ground transfer, receipt section untouched. Expect complete true, totalRequired 27 (REC-02 and all RFR rules gated off), totalSatisfied 27, seven section buckets (no receipt bucket), empty missing, and zero flaggedIssues.

personas.name: Pregnant febrile patient by air with boundary vitals and half-filled receipt
personas.description: Island dispensary refers a 24-year-old woman at 34 weeks with suspected severe malaria by air; every vital sign sits exactly on a silent boundary (HR 130, RR 30, SBP 90, SpO2 90, GCS 9) except temperature 39.0, which fires at >= 39. 'Other' precaution ticked with no details; receiving facility has entered only the arrival time. Expect complete false, totalRequired 30 (27 + REC-02 + RFR-01 + RFR-02; RFR-03 stays gated off because provider name and signature are blank), totalSatisfied 27, missing in order REC-02, RFR-01, RFR-02, an eighth 'referralFacilityReceipt' bucket with required 2 / satisfied 0. flaggedIssues sorted: FLAG-VIT-TEMP (high), FLAG-PREG (high), FLAG-MODE (low, 'AIR'); no FLAG-PRC-OTHER because otherDetails is blank.
